_comment: Struct layout knowledge shared by tools/discover_values.py and
app/reader/values.ts. Both read this file; neither restates a value.
Hex strings so the numbers read the way they do in a debugger.
BINDING_VTABLE_RVA is bootstrapped per game build -- see the
discover_values.py docstring for how to re-derive it if a patch moves it.
This is the struct layout registry, not the set of keys either side
happens to consume: BINDING_SETTINGS_OFFSET is read only by the Python
chain walk today, and belongs here because it describes the same structs.
